name: Tm Custom Visualisation
pitch: Build a Qlik view from your own HTML and CSS, or start with one of seven presets.
question: How can I shape a Qlik object around the story in my data?
questions: Can I use my own HTML and CSS to design a Qlik view?
How can I show data as a list, table, grouped view or KPI cards?
Can I add selections and keyboard access to my custom template?
useWhen: Design a data view with a template or preset.
audience: Qlik analysts who want to design a data view with their own HTML and CSS.
features: Design the object with your own HTML and CSS
Start from seven presets, including tables, lists and KPI cards
Use values, loops, conditions, groups and template helpers
Load up to 20,000 rows in checked pages with exact Qlik totals
Add selections, keyboard access and Qlik-style tooltips
Run an optional author script in a sealed frame

featureStrips.heading: Make the layout yours
featureStrips.text: Write HTML and CSS for your data, or load a preset and adapt its template.
featureStrips.alt: The same monthly sales shown as a ranked list with bars and an SVG bar chart in month order.

featureStrips.heading: Choose the right structure
featureStrips.text: Show detailed rows in a table or group products with their totals.
featureStrips.alt: The same category and product sales shown in a simple table and a grouped list.

featureStrips.heading: Work with large data
featureStrips.text: Load up to 20,000 rows in checked pages and show them a page at a time, with exact Qlik totals.
featureStrips.alt: A simple table of region, product, month and sales with a pager that reads Page 1 of 54.

featureStrips.heading: Follow the app theme
featureStrips.text: Leave colors unset to use the app theme, or choose a look in native Styling.
featureStrips.alt: Regional sales in the app theme beside the same data with a dark background and light text.

hero.alt: Product sales as a ranked list with bars beside a grouped list of products with category totals and shares, from synthetic showcase data.
